title: The Golden Coin Trade

story.ending: Both realise they traded junk and burst out laughing.

payoff.text: Both items are worthless, so nobody was scammed after all.

title: The Scariest Campfire Story
logline: Pip tells a spooky campfire story about a buzzing monster. The monster is Pip's own phone.

story.conflict: Pip's story is getting a little too real for Bloxy.
story.stakes: Bloxy is one creak away from running home.
story.reveal: The buzzing in the bushes is Pip's phone, which Pip dropped there.
story.ending: Pip screams at their own ringtone; Bloxy deadpans.

hook.text: Pip leans into the firelight: "Have you heard of the buzzing one?"
hook.question: Is something out there?

payoff.text: The "monster" is Pip's phone, and Pip is the one who screams.

Bloxy stares at the camera, unimpressed.

lines.text: Pfft. I'm not scared of stories.

lines.text: It hides in bushes. It buzzes... before it strikes!

metadata.title: The Scariest Campfire Story
